connector.name: Imagine MCP
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for image/video understanding & generation (Gemini/OpenAI/Grok)
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package imagine-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the n24q02m account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: UNDERSTAND_MODELS
env.description: Ordered model chain for the understand path 'provider/model,...' (order = litellm fallback; provider inferred from the prefix). Empty = understand off (provider/tier catalog default). Generation stays provider/tier native.
